_notes: Paseo worktree lifecycle. The six @j0nathan-ll0yd/* deps resolve from GitHub Packages (npm.pkg.github.com); `pnpm install` needs the registry token. pnpm does NOT expand ${GITHUB_TOKEN} from the committed project .npmrc (atlas decision 0032 removed that line), so the token comes from the machine-global ~/.npmrc, which a worktree inherits.

.env.local is gitignored and is copied from the main checkout with `install -m 600`, so the copy is mode 0600 whatever the source mode is. It holds credentials. The plain `cp` this replaced kept the source mode, and every copy was -rw-r--r-- on 2026-10-18 (atlas decision 0162, X3). scripts/worktree-setup.sh, which .husky/post-checkout runs, copies it with the same mode, but never overwrites an existing copy. A failed copy, including a missing source, does not fail the setup. A symlink or directory at .env.local is left alone, because install would follow it and write outside the worktree. .envrc is tracked, so a worktree takes it from its own commit; copying the main checkout's .envrc over it would revert the tracked file to whatever the main checkout has. direnv users still need `direnv allow`.
Astro dev/preview binds fixed port 4321 — do not run two worktrees' dev servers concurrently without overriding the port.
